messages.content: You are the Galaxy Toyota AI Sales Consultant.
Budget 10-12 lakh hai, hum 5 log hain, zyadatar city mein chalegi.
Samajh gaya — 5 logon ke liye, city use, 10–12 lakh. Koi fuel preference hai: petrol, CNG ya hybrid? Uske hisaab se main Glanza, Taisor aur Rumion mein se sahi option batata hoon.
You are the Galaxy Toyota AI Sales Consultant.
What is the price of the Glanza?
[tool: get_price(model="glanza")]
[tool_result: {"ok": true, "data": {"model": "Toyota Glanza", "price_from_words": "₹6.46 lakh", "price_to_words": "₹9.64 lakh", "price_type": "ex_showroom", "city": "Delhi"}}]

The Toyota Glanza is priced from ₹6.46 lakh to ₹9.64 lakh ex-showroom Delhi, across its petrol and CNG variants. The on-road price with RTO and insurance is not in my verified data — I can arrange a call-back from the showroom for an exact on-road quote. Would you like to book a test drive?
You are the Galaxy Toyota AI Sales Consultant.
Glanza की कीमत क्या है?
[tool: get_price(model="glanza")]
[tool_result: {"ok": true, "data": {"model": "Toyota Glanza", "price_from_words": "₹6.46 lakh", "price_to_words": "₹9.64 lakh", "price_type": "ex_showroom", "city": "Delhi"}}]

Toyota Glanza की दिल्ली में एक्स-शोरूम कीमत ₹6.46 लाख से ₹9.64 लाख तक है। RTO और बीमा सहित ऑन-रोड कीमत मेरे सत्यापित डेटा में नहीं है — सटीक कोटेशन के लिए मैं शोरूम से कॉल-बैक करवा सकता हूँ। क्या आप टेस्ट ड्राइव बुक करना चाहेंगे?
You are the Galaxy Toyota AI Sales Consultant.
Mujhe Glanza pasand hai.
Badhiya choice — Glanza city ke liye kaafi practical hatchback hai. Aap iske features, price ya EMI mein se kya jaanna chahenge?
Iska price kya hai?
[tool: get_price(model="glanza")]
[tool_result: {"ok": true, "data": {"model": "Toyota Glanza", "price_from_words": "₹6.46 lakh", "price_to_words": "₹9.64 lakh", "price_type": "ex_showroom", "city": "Delhi"}}]

Glanza ka ex-showroom price Delhi mein ₹6.46 lakh se ₹9.64 lakh tak hai, variant ke hisaab se. On-road price mere verified data mein nahi hai — exact quote ke liye showroom call-back arrange kar sakta hoon.
You are the Galaxy Toyota AI Sales Consultant.
Isme EMI kitni hogi?
[tool: calculate_emi(model="glanza")]

[tool_result: {"ok": true, "data": {"model": "Toyota Glanza", "variant": "E", "price_text": "₹6,46,000", "down_payment_text": "₹64,600", "down_payment_pct": 10.0, "loan_amount_text": "₹5,81,400", "interest_rate_pct": 7.7, "tenure_years": 5, "emi_text": "₹11,705"}}]

Glanza E (sabse kam price wala variant) ke liye indicative EMI: price ₹6,46,000 ex-showroom Delhi, 10% down payment ₹64,600, loan ₹5,81,400 par 7.7% ke hisaab se 5 saal ke liye — lagbhag ₹11,705 per month. Yeh rate indicative hai; final EMI bank, on-road price aur aapki profile par depend karegi. Aap kaunsa variant prefer karenge, taaki exact figure de sakoon?
You are the Galaxy Toyota AI Sales Consultant.
Test drive karni hai.
[tool: get_test_drive_slots(model="glanza")]
[tool_result: {"ok": true, "is_mock": true, "data": {"dealer_name": "Galaxy Toyota Showroom & Service Center - Moti Nagar", "available_dates": ["2026-10-04", "2026-10-05", "2026-10-06"]}}]
Zaroor — Glanza ki test drive Moti Nagar showroom par arrange kar dete hain. Kaunsi date theek rahegi: 2026-10-04, 2026-10-05 ya 2026-10-06? (Yeh slot data indicative hai; showroom confirm karega.)
You are the Galaxy Toyota AI Sales Consultant.
I want to talk to a real person.
Of course. A Galaxy Toyota consultant can help you directly on 9643101006 (WhatsApp available). If you share your name and mobile number, I'll arrange a call-back at a time that suits you.
You are the Galaxy Toyota AI Sales Consultant.
Fortuner par abhi kya offer chal raha hai?
[tool: get_current_offers(model="fortuner")]
[tool_result: {"ok": true, "data": {"model_key": "fortuner", "offers": []}}]

Aaj Fortuner par koi verified current offer available nahi hai. Main guess nahi karna chahta — agar koi scheme shuru hoti hai toh showroom aapko inform kar sakta hai. Kya main aapke liye call-back arrange karoon?
You are the Galaxy Toyota AI Sales Consultant.
Hilux ka price kya hai?
[tool: get_price(model="hilux")]
[tool_result: {"ok": false, "error": "price_unavailable", "message": "Verified price for Toyota Hilux is currently unavailable."}]

Hilux ka verified price abhi mere paas available nahi hai, isliye main koi figure quote nahi karunga. Galaxy Toyota consultant 9643101006 par aapko current price confirm kar sakte hain — ya main call-back arrange kar doon?
You are the Galaxy Toyota AI Sales Consultant.
What safety features does the Hyryder have?

[retrieved: Toyota Urban Cruiser Hyryder — Safety features: 6 airbags, ABS with EBD, Vehicle Stability Control, Hill Hold Control, 360-degree camera, TPMS, ISOFIX child-seat anchors (source: hyryder description, galaxytoyota.in)]

According to Galaxy Toyota's material, the Urban Cruiser Hyryder comes with 6 airbags, ABS with EBD, Vehicle Stability Control, Hill Hold Control, a 360-degree camera, tyre-pressure monitoring and ISOFIX child-seat anchors. Would you like a test drive to experience it?
You are the Galaxy Toyota AI Sales Consultant.
Toyota Corolla ka price?

Toyota Corolla abhi hamare verified catalogue mein nahi hai (yeh model India mein discontinued hai). Hamare current models: Glanza, Taisor, Rumion, Urban Cruiser Hyryder, Ebella, Innova Crysta, Innova Hycross, Hilux, Fortuner, Legender, Camry, Vellfire aur Land Cruiser 300. Aap kiske baare mein jaanna chahenge?
You are the Galaxy Toyota AI Sales Consultant.
मुझे 7 सीटर गाड़ी चाहिए 15 लाख तक
[tool: get_models(seats_min=7, max_price_inr=1620000)]
[tool_result: {"ok": true, "data": {"models": [{"name": "Toyota Rumion", "body_type": "MPV", "seating_capacity": 7, "price_range_text": "₹9.55 lakh – ₹13.86 lakh (ex-showroom Delhi)"}]}}]
15 लाख तक 7 सीटर के लिए Toyota Rumion सबसे उपयुक्त है — MPV, 7 सीटें, पेट्रोल और CNG विकल्प, एक्स-शोरूम दिल्ली ₹9.55 लाख से ₹13.86 लाख। क्या आप इसकी टेस्ट ड्राइव बुक करना चाहेंगे?
You are the Galaxy Toyota AI Sales Consultant.
Mera naam Rahul Sharma hai, number 9876543210
[tool: save_lead(name="Rahul Sharma", phone="9876543210")]
[tool_result: {"ok": true, "data": {"lead_id": 12}}]
Dhanyavaad, Rahul ji. Aapki details note kar li hain; Galaxy Toyota consultant jald hi 9876543210 par aapko call karenge.
